premise.premise: consent prefill reads only this opening's fresh history

findings.source_line: P1 components/appointments/workflow-steps/consent-step.tsx:256 — A practitioner updates a returning patient’s history on their phone, then opens protocol consent on the clinic iPad with older cached history. Cached answers are prefilled immediately; after fresh history arrives, the tokens update but the answers remain stale because lines 259–273 preserve every nonempty value. Reproduced pregnancy “Yes” remaining after its indication disappears, smoking “No” remaining when current history says “Yes”, and submission containing the stale pregnancy answer — defer medical prefill until the current fetch succeeds, and distinguish generated answers from patient edits so refreshed history replaces or clears untouched prefills. [TM-07, DR-05, UI-04, H-U0]

P2 pages/api/clients/[id]/medical-history.ts:164 + lib/forms/prefill.ts:251 + lib/forms/consent-variables.ts:310 — H-U0 missing becomes "No" (newly exposed on this screen; same defect already tracked as AestheticcNext-e5hw9): the GET fills `smoking: false` for every exists:true record, and CSV import (pages/api/clients/import/batch.ts:458) creates a record with no smoking value. A practitioner opens the protocol Consent step for an imported client, and the consent text now prints "Smoking: No" and the smoking radio is preselected "no". The client signs a clinical statement nobody recorded. This branch is what puts that value on this screen — fix: stop defaulting smoking in the GET (or have the helpers treat it as unknown unless the stored record carries it), add a test on an exists:true record with no smoking key that expects blank and unselected.

P3 tests/components/appointments/workflow-consent-medical-history.test.tsx — H-D1 the failed-fetch guard at components/appointments/use-consent-client.ts:39 (throw instead of caching an empty record, because the contraindication checker shares the key) has no test; reverting it to `return { medicalHistory: {}, exists: false }` leaves all 4 tests green — fix: add a test where the medical-history GET returns 500 and assert tokens are blank, nothing is prefilled, and the cached value is not an empty record. Not user-facing in this diff alone, so it may land on a one-line builder rejection.

P1 components/appointments/use-consent-client.ts:73 — Before treatment on the clinic iPad, a practitioner opens protocol consent after correcting allergies; if the fresh history fetch fails, older safety-banner allergies still prefill the allergy answer and token. A scratch reproduction submitted the stale allergy in the signed PUT payload — derive all medical answers and tokens exclusively from this opening's successful history response. [TM-07, DR-05, UI-04, H-U0]

P1 components/appointments/workflow-steps/merge-generated-prefill.ts:36 — Before treatment on the clinic iPad, a patient types then clears Medication during a slow history load. The arriving record refills the deliberately cleared answer; a scratch reproduction submitted the restored medication in the signed PUT — explicitly track user-edited fields, including empty answers, and exclude them from subsequent generated prefill. [TM-07, DR-05, UI-04, H-U0]

[COM-02, DR-06, H-D1]
